Typische Beispiele für relevante Metriken sind Geschossfläche, Anzahl Geschosse, Volumen und Gebäudehöhen. Um schnelle Entwicklungszyklen zu gewährleisten, und Änderungen an den Algorithmen auf Knopfdruck quantitativ und automatisiert bewerten zu können, ist syte auf hochwertige QA-Daten angewiesen. Um diesen Datensatz systematisch auszubauen und zu härten und damit die Grundlage, auf der unsere Algorithmen gemessen werden , zu entwickeln, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Münster. Deine Aufgaben Ground Truth Audit: Du evaluierst die Korrektheit bestehender Testdaten und ermittelst hierfür neue Metriken, die wir zur Evaluation unserer Algorithmen verwenden können. Edge Cases jagen: Du ermittelst neue Testdaten für schwierige Gebäude (z.B. komplexe Dachformen, Bäume über den Dächern) und integrierst diese in den Gesamtdatensatz. Data Sourcing: Du ermittelst potenzielle Quellen für neue Testdatensätze und integrierst diese möglichst automatisiert. Benchmarking & Insights: Du führst unsere Benchmarking-Pipelines aus, um sowohl die Algorithmen als auch die Qualität der Daten quantitativ zu bewerten. Die Ergebnisse dieser Analysen visualisierst und kommunizierst du verständlich, sodass sich daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten. Pipeline Engineering: Du implementierst und testest Verbesserungen in den Benchmarking-Pipelines und den Parametern der Algorithmen. Du hast auch einen gültigen Immatrikulationsnachweis. Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du arbeitest dich gerne tief in Daten ein und begeisterst dich für die statistische Analyse der Daten. B2). Pluspunkt : Du hast Vorerfahrungen in den Bereichen Architektur oder PropTech und erste Programmiererfahrungen mit Python. title: Werkstudent Marketing & Vertrieb (w/m/d)
description: Info Du studierst Marketing, Kommunikation, Betriebswirtschaft oder ein vergleichbares Fach und möchtest erste Praxiserfahrung im Marketing und Vertrieb sammeln? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und unterstütze uns mit deinen Ideen, deinen Recherchen und deinem Gespür für gute Inhalte dabei, academyFIVE noch sichtbarer zu machen. Wichtiger Hinweis: Unsere Unternehmenssprache sowie die Kommunikation mit unseren Hochschulkunden erfolgen vollständig auf Deutsch. Daher setzen wir für diese Position Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau voraus. Das erwartet dich Du unterstützt unser Marketing- und Vertriebsteam bei Recherchen zu Wettbewerbern, Markttrends und relevanten Entwicklungen im Hochschulmarkt. Du wirkst bei unseren Market Intelligence-Maßnahmen mit und bereitest relevante Informationen und Erkenntnisse strukturiert für das Team auf. Du unterstützt bei der Pflege und Anreicherung unserer Vertriebsdaten sowie bei der Dokumentation von Kunden- und Referenzprojekten. Du hilfst bei der Recherche, Erfassung und Nachverfolgung von Ausschreibungen. Du unterstützt bei Marketingaktivitäten rund um Content, Website, Newsletter, Events und Kampagnenreportings. Du wirkst bei der Betreuung unserer Partner und Kooperationen sowie bei gemeinsamen Marketingmaßnahmen mit. Voraussetzungen Laufendes Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs. Interesse an Marketing und Vertrieb im B2B-Umfeld sowie Freude an Recherche und neuen Themen. Strukturierte, sorgfältige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie ein gutes Gespür für Daten, Texte und Inhalte. Kommunikationsstärke, Teamgeist und Lust darauf, dich mit eigenen Ideen einzubringen. Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau (zwingend erforderlich) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse notwendig – beides in Wort und Schrift. Wohnsitz in Deutschland , da regelmäßige Zusammenarbeit vor Ort sowie arbeitsrechtliche Rahmenbedingungen dies voraussetzen. Warum Simovative? Startup-Spirit trifft auf Erfahrung : Wir sind seit vielen Jahren erfolgreich am Markt – und haben uns trotzdem ein Miteinander bewahrt, das offen, direkt und auf Augenhöhe ist. Arbeite so, wie du am produktivsten bist: Ob Homeoffice oder ein fester Arbeitsplatz in unserem Münchner Büro mit Dachterrasse und bester Anbindung – gemeinsam schaffen wir die Flexibilität, die du brauchst, um Studium und Beruf erfolgreich zu verbinden. Gut versorgt : Von Zuschuss zum ÖPNV über EGYM Wellpass bis hin zu Sportevents, freien Getränken und Obst im Office – wir sorgen dafür, dass du dich rundum wohlfühlst und fit bleibst. Ein Team, das zusammenhält : Flache Hierarchien, echtes Miteinander und Raum für Austausch – im Arbeitsalltag genauso wie beim Kicker oder auf der Dachterrasse. Mehr als nur Arbeit : Regelmäßige Events wie Sommerfest, Oktoberfest oder Teamevents sorgen dafür, dass der Spaß nicht zu kurz kommt. Sinn und Wirkung : Mit unserer Software gestalten wir die Bildung von morgen und übernehmen Verantwortung – auch über den Job hinaus, z. B. im Rahmen unserer Social Days. Your tasks – this is what awaits you in detail

  • You run and own our self-hosted Apache Kafka backbone and Schema Registry end-to-end, managing ACLs, client quotas, certificates, upgrades, and disaster recovery
  • You operate our Debezium-based change data capture pipelines, overseeing connectors, snapshots, offsets, replica lag, and BigQuery sink loaders 
  • You run our workloads on Kubernetes, including Navarch - our self-built workflow orchestrator executing ~7,500 SQL and Python tasks daily - owning resource management, autoscaling, and debugging
  • You automate and own access management and infrastructure as code across our self-hosted GitLab CI/CD pipelines, replacing manual tickets with code-driven policies
  • You own observability and infra costs - Datadog across Kafka and sink loaders, Slack-native alerting, and maintaining an honest view of K8s, Kafka retention, and log volume expenses
  • You carry your share of triage, one week in three - handling ingestion and access requests, schema alerts, and supporting analysts, while helping automate this layer via AI-assisted review
  • You act as a senior sparring partner alongside two senior data engineers (reporting to the Head of Data & Analytics) - driving design reviews and multi-quarter initiatives, with room to grow into BigQuery architecture over time: access frameworks, partitioning and slot strategy, the pipelines and models on top
  • Optional: You take part in our 24/7 on-call rotation


Profil

Your profile – this is what we expect from you

  • You have several years of experience operating production infrastructure you were personally responsible for, including on-call rotation. You have run systems that broke, can explain what went wrong and how you permanently fixed it, and can detail a specific trade-off you navigated backed by concrete numbers
  • You have deep hands-on expertise in Apache Kafka broker operations, including cluster sizing, partition rebalancing, replication, ISR behavior, and version upgrades
  • You have operated cross-system data replication in production - ideally Debezium on Kafka Connect, or database replication via binlog, GTID, WAL, or agent-based pipelines
  • You demonstrate strong production experience with Kubernetes, master resource management and autoscaling, and possess sharp debugging reflexes for complex failure modes
  • You manage infrastructure and access as code across multiple environments (ideally Terraform and Ansible; Pulumi, Helm or serious configuration management also counts) following a strict least-privilege IAM approach across multiple environments, ideally with GCP experience or transferable AWS/Azure knowledge
  • You use production-grade Python and SQL as practical tools, applying a cost-conscious mindset to query performance, scanning volume, and data pruning
  • You thrive in a low-process, Kanban-driven environment where seniors self-organize, rotate weekly triage duties without micro-management, and prefer automating recurring requests over manually repeating them
  • Optional: You bring skills or interest in object-oriented design, data modeling/dbt, BigQuery architecture, orchestration frameworks (Airflow, Dagster), stream processing (Beam, Flink, Spark), or internal automation (n8n, AI triage bots).
  • You are fluent in English (C1 level) and enjoy working in an international team environment

title: Senior Data Scientist - Business Operations
description: About Deliveroo Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day. Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. The Team BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next , for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day. We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large. Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it. We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked. The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast. The Role Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office). This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer. You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier. Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams. What You'll Be Doing Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?” Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions. Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams. Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone. Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language. Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm. Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions. Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others: Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential. Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar. Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility. A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact. Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view. Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions. Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations. Driven, hard-working, and agile. BizOps sits at the centre of a fast-growing business; we move quickly to scale at pace. London-based, with a minimum of three days per week in the office. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale : work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 🌱 See your impact, fast : ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership : take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support. 🌎 A culture built for builders : high standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning. 💰 Share in the success you help create : competitive salary and equity, so you're rewarded for the impact you make. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine; our interview typically includes 3 to 4 stages. Workplace & Benefits At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits across areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific; please ask your recruiter for more information. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are: your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry. We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. If you have a disability or long-term health condition, or require any reasonable adjustments to apply or fairly participate in the interview process, please let us know; we'll make every effort to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed. Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office).

This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer.

You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier.

Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?”

  • Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions.

  • Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams.

  • Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone.

  • Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language.

  • Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm.

  • Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions.

  • Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.

  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.

  • Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view.

  • Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations.

  • Driven, hard-working, and agile. BizOps sits at the centre of a fast-growing business; we move quickly to scale at pace.

  • London-based, with a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale: work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

  • 🌱 See your impact, fast: ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership: take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

  • 🌎 A culture built for builders: high standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.

  • 💰 Share in the success you help create: competitive salary and equity, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine; our interview typically includes 3 to 4 stages.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits across areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific; please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are: your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. If you have a disability or long-term health condition, or require any reasonable adjustments to apply or fairly participate in the interview process, please let us know; we'll make every effort to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

  • Design, document, and own the end-to-end credit control and collections process.

  • Decide the collections timetable and contact strategy for missed and failed payments, including frequency of contact and escalation points.

  • Create and continually improve customer communications, including email templates, reminders and telephone scripts.

  • Personally manage day-to-day collections across a high volume of customer accounts by telephone and email.

You will need strong hands-on experience in credit control, collections, or recurring payment recovery, ideally within a subscription, professional services, or other high-volume customer environment.

description: Our Mission We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers. Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond. Your Mission As our Software Engineer (Data) , you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements. You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way. What you’ll be working on Own everything that flows into Ben: build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them. Keep everything running on time: own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks. Scale and manage our data infrastructure: build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services. Connect Ben to every system our customers run: build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring. Build the data layer our agents act on: help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time. Shape what we build: work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions. Build it to enterprise standard: build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework. Behind the scenes Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS. Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements. We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies. Your skills and experience Strong experience with Python and SQL . A few years building and running production data pipelines that other people relied on. Comfortable with infrastructure as code , ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS. A good grasp of ETL/ELT and orchestration . Experience building or running data integrations and connectors , especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus. Solid software engineering fundamentals : clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on. You keep security in mind when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data. Nice to have, not essential : Experience working on customer-facing data integrations such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format Experience with MCP server development , or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers. We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it. Why join us? Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork. At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust. That raises questions a dashboard never had to answer. How fresh does this need to be for an agent to act on it? How do you match the same entity across tools? How do you control what an agent is allowed to see? Very few engineers have answered those in production. You'd be one of them. You'll take ownership of large, complex problem spaces, help design how they scale, and build an agentic layer few engineers have built anywhere yet, and you'll see the impact of it: Ben supports hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries. Our Compensation & Benefits It's important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. You'll have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, with the full offering here . 💰 Competitive base salary + equity, so you own what you build ⭐ Bonus scheme designed to reward and recognise high performance 💳 £100 monthly personal Ben Balance: for whatever works for you, whether that's Netflix, Spotify, or a really expensive cup of coffee! This allowance will increase by £50 for each year of service until you reach £250 🍔 Weekly lunch provided in office so you can spend quality time with the team over some tasty food! 🏖 28 days of holidays a year plus bank holidays, and an option to buy or sell 5 days per year. Your holiday entitlement increases to 30 days at your 3rd year of service! 🌴 Work-from-abroad scheme, so you can support your travels, enjoy an extended holiday, or visit loved ones. 🍼 Enhanced parental leave and workplace nursery scheme to support with the cost of childcare in a nursery setting ❤️ Comprehensive Private Medical Insurance 💌 Funded Life Assurance cover with the option to voluntarily increase. raw.title: Head of Key Account Management (m/f/d) - EMEA
raw.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About the role

This is one of the most important leadership hires in the EMEA business. The Head of KAM — EMEA will own Statista’s most strategically important accounts and lead the team that protects and grows the commercial relationships that underpin our 2026 stability and 2027 acceleration.

You will report directly to the VP Sales EMEA and sit on the EMEA commercial leadership team. This is not a steady-state account management role. It is a transformation mandate — to rebuild the KAM function into an enterprise-grade strategic account motion that moves our most important clients from users of data to institutional partners embedded in Statista’s AI and intelligence infrastructure.

What success looks like - First 12 months

• GRR stabilised across the KAM book through structured renewal discipline, early intervention on at-risk accounts, and a clear early-warning system.

• Every KAM account has a live account plan — org map, stakeholder map, expansion roadmap, and renewal forecast.

• Economic buyer engagement across the top tier — conversations at VP, Director, and C-suite level, not just with research and insights teams.

• Connect adoption initiated in strategically important accounts — from licence conversation to embedded data infrastructure.

• KAM team assessed, coached, and operating to an enterprise standard — structured QBRs, value realisation conversations, and expansion plays running consistently.

• Investment case for FY27 KAM expansion — headcount, coverage model, and tooling — presented to the CCO.

Your tasks

Lead and Transform the KAM Team

• Own the day-to-day leadership, coaching, and performance management of the EMEA KAM team.

• Assess each KAM against the enterprise motion requirements and build individual development plans. Not everyone will be on the same journey — that is a leadership decision, not a management failure.

• Build a coaching standard grounded in enterprise selling: consultative discovery, multi-stakeholder navigation, C-suite engagement, and business case construction.

• Develop the team’s ability to move from user-level relationships to economic buyer access — and to carry a complex, multi-product conversation with credibility.

• Install a peer coaching culture where KAMs learn from each other under a clear standard, not only from you.

Protect GRR in 2026

• Own the renewal and churn-prevention motion across the KAM book.

• Build an early-warning system for at-risk accounts — usage signals, stakeholder changes, competitor activity, budget cycles — with clear escalation and intervention protocols.

• Partner with Customer Success leadership to ensure joined-up coverage across adoption, value realisation, and renewal.

• Conduct and coach structured QBRs that demonstrate ROI and surface expansion signals — not renewal conversations dressed up as business reviews.

Drive the Enterprise Account Motion

• Build and embed the account planning standard across the KAM team — org mapping, stakeholder matrix, commercial roadmap, and expansion sequencing.

• Lead the movement from user-level selling to economic buyer engagement across the top-tier KAM book.

• Own the Connect and Statista+ expansion motion — identifying accounts where data infrastructure conversations are ready to open, and coaching KAMs to run them.

• Build the institutional knowledge that makes Statista’s largest accounts structurally difficult to displace.

Drive NRR Growth

• Own NRR targets across the KAM portfolio. Define the expansion plays that unlock commercial headroom in existing accounts.

• Identify accounts where Connect’s consumption-based model opens a new commercial conversation with a new buyer — technical, commercial, and C-suite.

• Create structured handoffs with the Customer Success and Scale teams to ensure expansion signals are acted on, not lost.

• Champion the full OneStatista platform — core, Connect, Statista+, and IQ roadmap — in every strategic account engagement.

Shape the Commercial Operating Model

• Define the KAM coverage model — which accounts receive full KAM attention, at what intensity, and how that changes as the portfolio evolves.

• Partner with the VP Sales EMEA on the FY27 KAM investment case — headcount, tooling, and the team structure required to operate an enterprise motion at scale.

• Represent EMEA KAM in global commercial leadership forums — bringing regional evidence and recommendations to shape global strategy and playbooks.

• Work closely with New Business leadership to ensure the accounts being landed are the right accounts — and that the handoff from new business to KAM is clean.

Your profile

Essential

• Substantial enterprise account management or key account leadership experience — managing strategic relationships at VP, Director, and C-suite level, with deals at £100k+ ACV.

• Evidence of building or materially improving a KAM or enterprise account function — account planning, coverage models, QBR standards, and expansion playbooks.

• Proven track record of protecting GRR and growing NRR in a subscription-based model.

• Commercial instinct for the enterprise motion — value discovery, business case construction, multi-stakeholder navigation, and land-and-expand execution.

• Experience developing and coaching account managers to raise the quality of their commercial conversations — not just their activity levels.

• Ability to lead change in a team that is transitioning from a transactional to an enterprise model — without losing the team in the process.

Desirable

• Experience in data, intelligence, research, information services, or AI-adjacent platforms.

• Familiarity with consumption-based or usage-based commercial models.

• Exposure to enterprise procurement, legal, and compliance conversations in regulated industries.

• Experience working across multiple European markets in a matrixed organisation.

Why join Statista?

• The most strategically important leadership role in the EMEA commercial organisation. What you build here defines Statista’s growth trajectory.

• Direct line to the VP Sales EMEA and CCO — your commercial judgement will shape decisions at the top of the business.

• A product story that is only getting stronger — Connect, Statista+, and StatistaIQ give you a genuinely differentiated platform to build enterprise relationships around.

• The mandate to rebuild for enterprise — with CEO and board alignment behind the direction. The strategy is set. The opportunity is to execute it.

• Real runway. Build this well in 2026 and you will own the enterprise account engine for one of the most recognised data platforms in the world.

Working Model and Compensation

• Hybrid working from our London office, with regular travel across EMEA and to Hamburg HQ.

• Competitive base salary commensurate with senior enterprise leadership — range shared at initial screen. Above-band compensation considered for exceptional candidates.

• Performance-linked OTE. Pension, private healthcare, and core benefits.

Recruitment Process

Shortlisted candidates will move through a structured process:

• Initial screen with Talent Acquisition.

• In-depth conversation with the VP Sales EMEA.

• Panel interview with CCO and a commercial peer.

• Strategic account plan presentation and live exercise.

Inclusive Application

Statista is committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from candidates with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We recognise that strong candidates may not meet every listed criterion. If the role interests you and your experience is relevant, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to discuss reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

 

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
